point-object.def: A model of an object as a single point with a position but no size, shape or inner parts.

time-interval.def: The time between two moments, Δt = final time minus initial time.

average-velocity.def: Displacement divided by the time interval: v = Δx/Δt, in m/s.

acceleration.def: The rate at which velocity changes, in m/s²; any change in speed or direction.

average-acceleration.def: Change in velocity divided by the time interval: a = Δv/Δt.

instantaneous-velocity.def: The velocity at one instant: the average velocity over a very short interval.

instantaneous-acceleration.def: The acceleration at one instant: the average acceleration over a very short interval.
